lines.text: Asaph cries aloud to God, and in his day of trouble his soul refuses to be comforted.
Asaph remembers God and groans, and his spirit grows faint because he is too troubled to speak.
Asaph asks whether the Lord will spurn His people forever and whether His anger has shut off His power.
Asaph decides to remember the works of the LORD, who redeemed the sons of Jacob and Joseph with power.
God's path led through the sea, and He led His people like a flock by the hand of Joshua and Caleb.
